integrity: Both finite verification programs are included and fully reproducible. The previously published six-color lower bound is credited. No claim of independent review or absolute publication priority.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact theorem for the canonical thirty-vertex graph only. Does not prove a seven-color upper bound for all cubic graphs of girth at least five; computational proof of six-color exclusion is finite and exhaustive, independently replayed. Unindexed prior computation remains possible.
title: Seven strong edge colors and ten extremal induced matchings of the Tutte–Coxeter graph
